selection.ownership: Klangio GmbH, Alter Schlachthof 39, 76131 Karlsruhe, Germany (HRB 730768 Mannheim). The reviewed edition is the public international REST API at api.klang.io, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official Klangio API (https://klang.io/api/, https://docs-api.klang.io/), pinned OpenConnector actions (multipart POST job creation, GET /job/{jobId}/status, binary downloads via transit storage), kl-api-key header, Karlsruhe GmbH identity, and dated incident search. No qualifying current unresolved Klangio customer-data compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim. Native template cannot express multipart job creation or transit-file downloads. Pinned credential validator GETs a dummy UUID status path and treats HTTP 404 as success, which is not a cheap account/list healthcheck.

Official Klangio product/API pages document music transcription, source separation, beat tracking, chord and strum recognition at https://api.klang.io. Pinned source authenticates with kl-api-key. Job creation is multipart/form-data POST. Job status is GET /job/{jobId}/status. Downloads require connector transit storage. Pinned validator uses GET /job/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/status and accepts 404. Operator is Klangio GmbH, Karlsruhe, Germany. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying current unresolved Klangio compromise.

incidents.finding: Bounded search of Klangio / Klangio GmbH security breach and incident coverage on 2026-09-13 identified no current unresolved customer-data compromise. Hits for Kling AI / KL-API video generation are distinct products.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified. docs-api.klang.io did not resolve from this authoring environment; coverage uses the public API marketing pages plus pinned source.
